title: The rest countdown on the watch's card and watch face can read one second less than the app screen
what: The watch app's own rest screen rounds the seconds left up, on purpose, so it never shows 0:00 before the buzz. The rest card and the 'Rest 1:23' chip on the watch face are drawn by the watch's system timer from the same end time, which normally drops the part second instead. So for most of every rest the card and the chip read one second less than the app screen, and they can show 0:00 up to a second before the buzz. Not watched on a real watch; the system timer's rounding is the platform's, not our code.
expected: Every place the watch shows the same rest shows the same seconds left.
fix_line: Round the app screen the same way as the system timer, or start the card's timer half a second later, so all places agree

items.reason: The watch shows no gym facts (alerts, dues, plan end, birthdays, members using the app); it shows only workout facts. Rest time, set position, last time and target are all made once on the phone and only drawn on the watch; the rest time is the one fact drawn two ways on the watch itself.

No day-count numbers on the watch. Time edges checked: 0 or past end reads 0:00 and buzzes only if recent, a rest arriving late buzzes only within 5 s, a saved rest over a minute old reads as none, an hour or more reads h:mm:ss, -15 never ends sooner than 1 s from now (same rule on the phone), a workout silent for 4 hours reads as none. Workout-only data, so no Crispy Curves rows to count.
No number found wrong at those edges.

The only summary beside rows is the set ring (Set 3 of 5); it is read from the same phone line that names the set. The 'N sets done' line on Exercise done was removed (R-368), so no total can disagree. Nothing on the watch can drop from last time.
No summary differs from its rows.
Set ring and 'Set 3 of 5' come from one phone function; the weight and reps boxes come from one function and the 'Next 62.5 kg x 8' line from another; the rest after a watch-logged set from a third.

Compared the boxes and the goal line: both take the typed number, else the same hint, so a member back after a long gap sees the same last-time numbers in both; they differ only where a hint is 0, already covered by FN-B-truth-watch-app-a-03 (empty weight). Last time is one function for all places on the watch.
